description: This file defines the interface for managing Git worktrees, including functions for retrieving, validating, repairing, and manipulating worktrees and their metadata.

methods.name: get_worktrees
methods.description: Retrieve the list of worktrees, with the primary first.

methods.name: get_worktrees_without_reading_head
methods.description: Retrieve worktrees without reading HEAD, useful when HEAD may be inconsistent.

methods.name: submodule_uses_worktrees
methods.description: Check if linked submodules utilize worktrees at the specified path.

methods.name: get_worktree_git_dir
methods.description: Get the git directory of the specified worktree.

methods.name: find_worktree
methods.description: Find a worktree by a user-supplied identifier, such as a pathname or shorthand.

methods.name: get_linked_worktree
methods.description: Retrieve a linked worktree by its ID.

methods.name: find_worktree_by_path
methods.description: Find a worktree based on its filesystem path.

methods.name: is_main_worktree
methods.description: Determine if a worktree is the main one.

methods.name: worktree_lock_reason
methods.description: Get the reason why a worktree is locked, if applicable.

methods.name: worktree_prune_reason
methods.description: Get the reason why a worktree should be pruned.

methods.name: should_prune_worktree
methods.description: Decide if a worktree should be pruned, providing reason and path.

methods.name: validate_worktree
methods.description: Validate the integrity of a worktree.

methods.name: update_worktree_location
methods.description: Update the location of a worktree, modifying its path.

methods.name: repair_worktrees
methods.description: Attempt to repair linked worktrees and record callbacks.

methods.name: repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair worktrees after moving the git directory.

methods.name: repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair an individual worktree after moving its git directory.

methods.name: repair_worktree_at_path
methods.description: Repair a worktree by its filesystem path, repairing administrative files.

methods.name: free_worktree
methods.description: Free memory allocated for a single worktree.

methods.name: free_worktrees
methods.description: Free memory allocated for a list of worktrees.

methods.name: find_shared_symref
methods.description: Check if a symref points to a ref in a worktree, returning that worktree if so.

methods.name: is_shared_symref
methods.description: Check if a symref points to a ref in a worktree.

methods.name: other_head_refs
methods.description: Apply a callback to all HEAD refs except the current one in the worktree.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_rebased
methods.description: Determine if a worktree is currently rebasing.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_bisected
methods.description: Determine if a worktree is currently bisecting.

methods.name: strbuf_worktree_ref
methods.description: Construct a refname string for a worktree into a strbuf.

methods.name: init_worktree_config
methods.description: Enable worktree configuration, adjusting config files accordingly.

methods.name: write_worktree_linking_files
methods.description: Write .git and gitdir files linking the worktree to the repository.

ctags.name: head_ref
ctags.pattern: /^	char *head_ref;		\/* NULL if HEAD is broken or detached *\/$/

ctags.name: worktree_repair_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(int iserr,const char * path,const char * msg,void * cb_data)
